Mechanics of pods hidden; users see named applications
note: Both personas drive the P0 surface

title: The Runpod Stack
bullets: Resources — repeatable sandbox definition; Apps built on top (buildpacks-spirit, not buildpacks)
Snapshot / suspend / resume — filesystem-only to start (EBS-style, not CRIU/CUDA)
Routing — endpoint ↔ sandbox ↔ inference ↔ tools ↔ sandbox
Auth — lightweight but safe; Cloudflare Worker bindings as reference model

title: Top 3 Tentpoles — what carries the demo?
bullets: All 5 are P0, but which 3 are load-bearing for the first demo?
Proposed: Resources + Routing + Auth — the trio that lets an agent actually do work
Snapshot/resume: necessary, but filesystem-only deferrable past first demo
Telemetry: necessary for ops, not for the user-visible story
Open for discussion — change my mind

title: Roadmap
bullets: P0 — Sandbox foundation: resources + routing + auth, filesystem snapshots, telemetry (Goal 2)
P1 — Apps layer on top: named agent harnesses (Hermes, Pi) + connectable databases (Chroma) (Goal 3)
P1 — Extend snapshots beyond filesystem: process state + memory (when EBS-style no longer enough)
P1 — Durable execution layer: restate / temporal / inngest
P1 — CLI/MCP polish for the R2D2 path (Goal 1)
P2 / research — fine-tune + tool accumulation, tendril-style
